title: Shopping cart reducer
summary: Write a pure reducer and drive a component with `useReducer`.
prompt: Finish `cartReducer`. "add" puts an item in with quantity 1, or adds 1 to an existing line. "remove" drops a line. "setQuantity" changes a line, and removes it when the quantity is 0 or less. "clear" empties the cart. Never mutate `state`: return new objects. `Cart` shows "Total: $N.NN".
hints: Every branch returns `{ ...state, items: … }` built with `map` or `filter`.
Throw on unknown actions, so typos fail loudly.
